sources.title: RAG Techniques | IBM
sources.snippet: Language models (LLMs) generated at a large scale have transformed AI applications; however, they still have a serious drawback that their knowledge is not evolving and that it is static and can only come from their training data. This is where Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) comes into play.
